description: This class, JwtConfig, manages JWT-related configuration for the application, including generating tokens, obtaining the authorization header name, and creating refresh token cookies. It uses Spring Boot annotations for configuration properties and Lombok for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: JwtConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for managing JWT tokens, including token creation, header retrieval, and refresh token cookies.

methods.name: getAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Returns the name of the authorization header used in HTTP requests, typically 'Authorization'.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token based on the authentication result, using either access or refresh token expiration settings.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Private helper method that creates a JWT with the subject, authorities, issued date, expiration date, and signs it with the provided key.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenCookie
methods.description: Creates a secure, HTTP-only cookie containing the refresh token.
